title: Which line breaks it?
statement:
```python
v = [1, 2, 3]
v = v.append(4)
print(len(v))
```

Which line causes the error?

[_]{a}

choices: Line 3: v is None after line 2, so len(v) fails
explanations: It runs; it just stores None.

solution: `v = v.append(4)` stores None; `len(None)` raises TypeError on line 3.
